theorem.name: COMPONENT_MESSAGE_SELECTOR_COMPILATION_V1
theorem.input: Final post-seed-two state with fixed S,X0 and all residual Y0 components compiled by C0.

exact_outside_lists.definition: For each dynamic u in U=X union Y, A(u)=[4]\f(N(u) intersect (S union X0)).
exact_outside_lists.reason: These are the exact colors compatible with already fixed vertices. Source L_P(u) remains provenance/classification metadata only and is not substituted for A(u), preserving the B1B0 firewall.

selector_graph_Hstar.vertices: U plus h_{C,M} for every residual component C and every M in MIN_BAD(C)

local_selector_equivalence.statement: For fixed outside coloring c of U, selector h_{C,M} can be colored iff M is not a subset of F_C(c).
local_selector_equivalence.proof: h_{C,M} needs a color alpha in M absent from colors(D_C)=F_C(c), so it is colorable iff M\F_C(c) is nonempty.

component_equivalence.statement: For fixed outside coloring c, all selectors belonging to C can be colored iff mu_C(F_C(c))=1.
proof: C0 gives a monotone good-mask down-set and MIN_BAD(C), the inclusion-minimal bad masks.
A mask F is bad iff it contains at least one M in MIN_BAD(C).
Thus F is good iff for every M in MIN_BAD(C), M is not a subset of F.
By the local selector equivalence, this is exactly simultaneous colorability of all selectors of C.

global_equivalence.statement: The original final seeded-precoloring has an extension iff the selector list instance (H*,L*) has a list-coloring.
forward: Restrict an original extension to U.
For every C and M in MIN_BAD(C), original component extendability gives M not subseteq F_C, so choose any selector color alpha in M\F_C.
Selectors are independent, yielding a list-coloring of H*.
reverse: Take any list-coloring c* of H* and restrict it to U.
For each C compute the actual nonempty F_C(c*) from D_C.
Selector properness implies every M in MIN_BAD(C) is not contained in F_C, hence mu_C(F_C)=1.
Fetch the explicit C0 witness coloring stored for this allowed reachable nonempty mask.
The witness respects X0 through B_C, seed is anticomplete to C, complete dynamic neighbors avoid F_C colors by construction, and anticomplete dynamic vertices impose no constraint.
Distinct residual Y0 components are anticomplete, so all stored component witnesses combine with c*|U and fixed S union X0 into one original extension.
global_equivalence.reconstruction_runtime: Polynomial: compute each F_C by scanning D_C and retrieve one of at most 15 stored witnesses per component.

transformation: Otherwise replace [C] by the independent false-twin class {h_{C,M}: M in MIN_BAD(C)}; every twin has exactly neighborhood D_C.
p7_preservation.false_twin_lemma: An induced path with at least four vertices contains at most one vertex from an independent false-twin class. If two occur at distance at least three, the path-neighbor of one is adjacent to the other and creates a chord; if at distance two, a second path-neighbor of one twin creates a chord to the other.
p7_preservation.lift_back: Any induced P7 in H* therefore uses at most one selector from each C; collapse each used selector to [C] to obtain the same induced P7 in the corresponding induced subgraph of Q_ALL, contradiction.

four_list_selector.statement: If [4] is in MIN_BAD(C), then MIN_BAD(C)={[4]}.
four_list_selector.proof: MIN_BAD(C) is an antichain and every other mask is a proper subset of [4].
four_list_selector.semantics: The unique 4-list selector is colorable iff at least one of the four colors is absent from D_C: a NO_ALL_FOUR_COLORS constraint.

normal_form.residual_object: One P7-free list-coloring graph H* with original dynamic vertices plus a stable selector side.
normal_form.selector_lists: nonempty subsets of [4], with the only size-4 case being the singleton NO_ALL_FOUR selector for its component.
normal_form.original_dynamic_lists: exact A(u) including fixed X0 effects; source X/Y list classes retained only as metadata.

firewalls: H* P7-free does not imply List-4-Coloring is polynomial on H*.
Different size-3 selector lists need not lie in one common 3-color palette.
List 4-Coloring is known NP-complete already on P6-free graphs, so this is a normal form rather than a solver.
No promotion of a semantic equivalence between this selector normal form and source axioms (vi)-(viii) beyond the exact extension equivalence proved above.
